name: prompt3000
description: > **Turn messy thoughts into high-performing AI prompts — effortlessly.**   > Skip the tedious typing with intelligent voice shortcuts and instant prompt enhancement, delivered directly to your favorite browser.

scripts.build:safari:app: npm run build:safari && DEVELOPER_DIR=/Applications/Xcode.app/Contents/Developer xcrun safari-web-extension-converter .output/safari-mv2 --project-location .output/safari-app --app-name Prompt3000 --swift --macos-only --no-open --no-prompt --force
scripts.run:safari: DEVELOPER_DIR=/Applications/Xcode.app/Contents/Developer xcodebuild -project .output/safari-app/Prompt3000/Prompt3000.xcodeproj -scheme "Prompt3000" -destination "platform=macOS" CODE_SIGN_IDENTITY="" CODE_SIGNING_REQUIRED=NO CODE_SIGN_ENTITLEMENTS="" CODE_SIGNING_ALLOWED=NO build && open $(find ~/Library/Developer/Xcode/DerivedData/Prompt3000-*/Build/Products/Debug -name "Prompt3000.app" -maxdepth 1)
